ja: 大河原邦男デザインのこだわりのメカを詰め込んだハロがFigure-rise Mechanicsで初立体化！
• 外装はノーマル外装、クリア外装などの３種が付属。
• 目のパーツはハロプラモデル初ギミックの可動式。通常の表情に加えて「怒り」「悲しみ」の表情付けができる。
• 手足を引き出すギミックで劇中のイメージに合わせたポーズを再現。
• 全高約80mm。このサイズならではの高密度なメカニカル感。
• 別売りのLEDユニットと組み合わせることで成形品越しに目が発光する演出も可能！
en: Haro, which is packed with special mechanisms designed by Kunio Okawara, is now available in Figure-rise Mechanics for the first time!
• Three types of exterior are included, including normal exterior and clear exterior.
• The eye parts are movable, the first gimmick of Haropla Model. In addition to the normal facial expressions, you can also express anger and sadness.
• Reproduce poses that match the images in the play with a gimmick that pulls out limbs.
• Overall height approximately 80mm. A high-density mechanical feel unique to this size.
• By combining with the separately sold LED unit, it is possible to make the eyes glow through the molded parts!
